reviews.body: Thanks for the fix! I checked the diff: it only adds the Claude 5 opus/sonnet/haiku fragments to the no-sampling and adaptive-thinking lists, and none of the new fragments match older ids such as claude-3-5-sonnet or sonnet-4-5. The new parametrized test covers adaptive thinking, output_config.effort and the dropped temperature. CI (3.11/3.12/3.13, frontend, smoke, docs) and CLA are all green. Merging.
